quote: The City Council may designate parking spaces upon City streets or in City parking facilities for the parking of City vehicles. It is unlawful to park a vehicle other than a City vehicle in any such space that has been duly posted or marked.

activation.condition: City Council designated space upon a City street or in a City parking facility, duly posted or marked.

obligation.description: A driver of a vehicle other than a City vehicle must not park it in the designated and duly posted or marked space.

timing.description: Applies during parking in the designated space; no statutory numeric duration is stated.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Whether the City-only designation was duly posted or marked requires independent source review.
Vehicle classification requires independent source records; livery and blueprint alone do not decide it.
